ChatGPT can now create GIFs using a prompt or a photo uploaded to the AI chatbot. 6 model, allows you to adjust the GIF’s animation speed, edit individual frames, and share it with others. Before this change, ChatGPT couldn’t natively generate GIFs in a single step. ” while also providing you with the option to change the playback speed and view it frame by frame. 6 update also enables faster image generation in ChatGPT, OpenAI says. The company says users now generate over 4 billion images per week across ChatGPT and its API, a jump from the 3 billion per week it reported in September .

sec.title: French bank confirms cyber heist, hackers suspected to have stolen an estimated $133 million
sec.brief: A major French banking firm confirmed it experienced a “sophisticated attack” following reports that hackers stole an estimated $133 million from the firm. Crédit Mutuel Arkéa said in a press notice that the attackers were able to make transfers using the bank’s own account after compromising an unnamed supplier. The statement stressed customer accounts were not accessed and that the incident would not impact customers’ assets. Details about the incident were first reported on Monday by ZachXBT, a pseudonymous American blockchain investigator who subsequently named Arkéa as the alleged victim and said the attack had run over several days. ZachXBT estimated the size of the theft at more than $133 million, based on withdrawals from cryptocurrency exchange accounts and transactions intending to launder the assets. ” It said: “As soon as the attack was detected, the necessary measures were taken under existing crisis procedures. ”
